title: Wing design: least cruise drag within the structural and stall limits
description: Vortex lattice and friction build-up, a learned model only when its measured cost pays off, the planform optimised for cruise drag within the root-bending, stall and span limits, and the design re-verified (pinneapple_design.aero.wing_design).
